description: Starts offboarding: stops the package's jobs, revokes its future automation authority and turns off its scheduled reports. Requires the client owner, accepted set to true and the fingerprint from preview_offboard. The phone number, connections, billing plan and history are kept.

accepted.description: Must be true to confirm the owner accepts the previewed effects.

expectedRevision.description: The installation revision you last read. The call is rejected if the installation has changed since.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint returned by the matching preview action.

installationId.description: The agency package installation to act on.

name: agency_installation_offboard
title: Offboard Installation
